Subject MON-06: a corrupted industrial security worker reconfigured into a RANGED threat, still visibly a ruined human. Hunched narrow torso in a torn desaturated petrol-blue utility vest, broad ochre work trousers, two steel-capped boots. Face is a distorted sallow grey skull with one intact dull ivory eye, mouth clamped by a heavy dark industrial respirator graft; no helmet and no armour suit. The entire RIGHT forearm (viewer left) has become a short massive metal pneumatic firing organ: one thick cylindrical steel barrel with a distinct dark circular aperture facing slightly toward the viewer, jagged pale bone and dark rust sinew fused around its rear. The barrel is his actual forearm, not a held gun, no hand or fingers on that end. One thick corrugated hose connects this arm to a squat compressor block embedded in his upper back, with broad dark red muscle visibly growing around it. His LEFT arm remains a thin recognizably human arm with a slack three-fingered deformed hand, distinct from torso.
Silhouette: asymmetrical, one forward horizontal cannon-arm and one hanging organic arm, narrow bent body, two planted boots; clearly different from the broad melee press-hybrid reference. Human height equal to the possessed worker, not an elite giant. Clear negative space between firing organ, torso and legs. No firing projectile, no muzzle flash, no target line, no carried weapon, no long rifle, no separate backpack object floating away. Industrial conversion with disturbing flesh-machine fusion, rather than a robot wearing human clothes.
